data.name: Courtyard by Marriott Santiago Las Condes
data.address: Av. Pdte. Kennedy 5601, 7560356 Las Condes, Región Metropolitana, Chile
data.description:
Set in the affluent Las Condes district, this sophisticated hotel with views of the Andes is a 2-minute walk from high-end shopping at Falabella Parque Arauco and 14 km from La Moneda Palace, home to the presidential offices.
Featuring city or mountain views, the modern rooms have free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, minifridges, and tea and coffeemakers. Suites add separate living spaces, pull-out sofas and whirlpool tubs.
A laid-back bistro/bar serves breakfast and dinner. There's also a fitness room, and an indoor rooftop pool with views of the mountains.
